clue.text: Comparatively clever fraud

definitions.meaning: the comparative of an adjective meaning quick-witted or smart
a cheat or swindler, especially at cards

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the comparative of keen-witted; the other is a card cheat or swindler.

clue.text: It may be in the bag for a freeloader

definitions.text: It may be in the bag
definitions.meaning: a washbag or toilet bag holds a soft bath cleaner
one who lives off others, a scrounger

explanation.definitionFit: The bath item lives in a washbag; a scrounger soaking up others' generosity is also called this.

clue.text: Craftsman's skill providing queen with diamonds

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of persuasion
if means provided that
ice is slang for diamonds
R is Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A jeweller's skill lets him furnish a monarch with gems.
explanation.walkthrough: ICE is slang for diamonds; R (Regina) is queen. The queen comes first in the clue but last in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

clue.text: South African shrub with name that keeps changing

parts.note: the protea is a South African flowering shrub

explanation.surface: A plant from the Cape whose name is always being revised.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition, an adjective phrase, hides at the end behind the botany.
explanation.definitionFit: From Proteus, the sea god who changed shape, so variable and ever-shifting.

clue.text: Dress in a new creation to produce sexual excitement

indicators.note: a creation is something newly made, so the letters are fashioned into a fresh form

explanation.surface: A designer's new outfit is meant to arouse the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'creation' rearranges DRESS IN A with N (new). The fashion sense of 'creation' disguises the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The state of being lustful, sexual arousal.

clue.text: Bankrupt was first to be scuttled

parts.note: a firm gone bust is bankrupt
to have led is to have been first, in front

explanation.surface: A ruined business that was once the market leader has been sunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scuttled' suggests a ship deliberately sunk, but here it means hurried along with short quick steps.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs describe hurrying about busily with quick short movements.

clue.text: Singers perch on one

parts.note: the bass is a fish of the perch family
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Songbirds sit on a single branch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perch' looks like a verb for birds; it is the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian plural of a low-voiced male singer.

clue.text: Very little insect in tin

indicators.note: the insect sits inside the symbol for tin

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
a midge is a tiny biting insect

explanation.surface: A tiny bug trapped in a can.
explanation.walkthrough: SN is the chemical symbol for tin.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny amount, a scrap.

clue.text: Beast of burden upset a shopping area

indicators.note: in a down clue the phrase is turned upside down, read from bottom to top

parts.note: a mall is a shopping centre

explanation.surface: A pack animal runs amok in a shopping precinct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns A MALL upside down in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An Andean animal used to carry loads.

clue.text: Groom takes time training for the event

parts.note: to dress is to groom, as in dressing hair
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A stable lad takes his time preparing for the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Groom' suggests stables, but here it means dress.
explanation.definitionFit: Training a horse in precise movements, also the equestrian event that tests it.

clue.text: Expenditure for excursions

definitions.meaning: money spent, costs going out of the account

explanation.definitionFit: The word means money spent; read literally it is a set of trips out.

clue.text: Furious note by Gershwin

parts.note: Ira Gershwin, the lyricist brother of George
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: An angry musical note penned by the Gershwin brothers.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites George; the brother needed is the lyricist Ira.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: both mean very angry, enraged.

clue.text: Foreman has no right to make a blunder

indicators.note: the foreman word is said to lack something, so it is taken out

parts.note: a gaffer is a foreman or boss

explanation.surface: A works foreman who lacks authority is bound to slip up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no' removes R from GAFFER (a British word for the boss or foreman).
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a social slip or embarrassing mistake.

clue.text: Mica is put in barometer

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
a weather glass is an old name for a barometer

explanation.surface: Mineral is placed inside a weather instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: A barometer was traditionally called the glass. 'put' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The word has been used for thin transparent sheets of mica, as in stove windows.

clue.text: Superior criminal going down

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
descending means moving downwards

explanation.surface: A lofty convict being sent down to prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Superior' here means haughty, looking down on others, not better.
explanation.definitionFit: A superior manner is patronising, treating others as beneath oneself.

clue.text: Dog to work with troops in these mountains

parts.note: the cairn is a small Scottish terrier
to go is to work, function, as in the engine will not go
RM is the Royal Marines

explanation.surface: Dogs and soldiers are sent to operate in the Highlands.
explanation.walkthrough: A CAIRN is a Scottish terrier; RM, the Royal Marines, are British troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish mountain range, an example of mountains.

clue.text: Disorderly partisan

definitions.meaning: not in order, uneven or unruly
a guerrilla fighter outside the regular army

explanation.definitionFit: It means not following a pattern, and also a fighter not in the regular army.

clue.text: Scout leader under canvas is not doing job properly

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: living in a tent is camping

explanation.surface: A scoutmaster off in his tent is shirking.
explanation.definitionFit: To skimp work is to do it hastily and carelessly.

clue.text: Reprimand fielder for a loose shoe

parts.note: to carpet someone is to call them in and reprimand them
slip is a fielding position in cricket, beside the wicketkeeper
per means for each, for a, as in a pound per head

explanation.surface: A cricket captain tells off one of his fielders over footwear.
explanation.walkthrough: SLIP is a cricket fielding position near the batsman; 'carpet' is British for reprimand.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft slip-on footwear worn loosely around the house.

clue.text: Came on stage to be introduced

explanation.definitionFit: An actor walking on did this; data put into a record has also been put in this way.

clue.text: Bill taking note to back door

parts.note: a bill is a printed notice or poster

explanation.surface: Someone pins a notice on the back entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a name or an invoice; it is a printed notice.
explanation.definitionFit: A rear or side gate of a castle or fort.

clue.text: Part of gun needing a certain amount of oil

definitions.meaning: the tube a bullet travels along
a standard measure of crude oil, 42 US gallons

explanation.definitionFit: It is the tube of a firearm and also a standard measure of crude oil.

clue.text: Tom Thumb was such a ready soldier

definitions.meaning: Tom Thumb was a tiny man, read as minute, very small
an American militiaman of the Revolution, ready to fight at a minute's notice

explanation.definitionFit: Read as tiny plus fellow it fits the fairy-tale figure; it also names a colonial militiaman ready to fight at short notice.

clue.text: Setting for sculpture, a little Hellenic head

indicators.note: a little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small Greek bust displayed in an alcove.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess in a wall made to hold a statue.

clue.text: He often puts on a stone at work

definitions.text: He often puts on a stone at work

parts.words: He often puts on a stone at work
parts.note: reads like someone gaining weight on the job; really a builder laying stone on stone

explanation.definitionFit: A builder in stone lays one block on another as his trade.

clue.text: Old character's timeless dishonour

indicators.note: the dishonour word is left without its time, so the letter for time drops out

parts.note: a stigma is a mark of disgrace or dishonour

explanation.surface: An ancient figure carries a disgrace that never fades.
explanation.walkthrough: 'timeless' removes T (time) from STIGMA. 'Old character' is a letter of an old alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek letter, so a character of an ancient alphabet.

clue.text: Become subject to elected scoundrel

parts.note: a party voted in has been elected
a cur is a contemptible man, a scoundrel

explanation.surface: Falling under the control of a rogue who won the vote.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring a cost or penalty on oneself is to become liable to it.

clue.text: One can shift a lot of duck

definitions.meaning: someone using a spade moves a lot of earth
a dabbling duck with a broad spade-like bill

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally it is a person with a spade; it is also a broad-billed duck.

clue.text: Undergo treatment for payment

indicators.note: the letters of the first word are given a treatment, worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Agreeing to medical treatment in return for a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: An old literary word for a reward or recompense.

clue.text: Cross as a boxer, to some extent, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a cross is a hybrid, an animal of mixed breed

definitions.text: a boxer, to some extent, perhaps
definitions.meaning: a dog that is only partly boxer is of mixed breed

explanation.definitionFit: A dog of mixed breed is a hybrid, and one partly boxer is an example.
